## Activity

During October 2019, Market Eye Clinic completed 357 captures. This report summarises activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for the month. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing the clinic’s screening workload and identifying any operational issues requiring follow-up.

## Image quality

A total of 12 captures were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.4%. These images could not be assessed for grading purposes and should be considered when reviewing capture procedures and equipment performance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 51 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This measure should continue to be monitored alongside capture activity and image quality, as timely grading supports the onward management of referable findings. The clinic should retain the monthly review of ungradable images, referable results, and grading lag as part of routine site operations.
